about: Store actions: starting records, one action, and the records it changes (final data per id). New ids are n1, n2, ... in the order rules.ts documents. Apps add "schema" when they save; these are the changes before that.

cases.about: A new task defaults to the Inbox, ordered by when it was made.
A new Next task goes to the end of Next.
Moving a task to Next puts it at the end.
Setting the flag a task already has changes nothing.
Finishing a task finishes its open subtasks.
A task only waiting on the finished one moves to Next (end of Next); one in Today stays; one still waiting on another open task stays. Deleted and missing tasks never block.
Un-finishing clears doneAt.
Finishing a weekly task files a copy (and its subtasks) for next week, notes unchecked, keeping the deadline the same distance from the start.
Un-finishing a repeating task deletes its still-open copy.
Finishing an open ticket task asks for notes first and changes nothing.
Resolving with notes finishes the task and asks the server to resolve the ticket.
Moving a ticket task to In Progress asks the server to start the ticket.
A future start date takes a top-level task off its list until then.
A start date of today or earlier moves the task into Today now.
Clearing the start date of a loose task puts it in the Inbox.
Tasks whose start date has arrived move into Today; In Progress stays; later and done ones stay; newer-format records are left alone.
Deleting a task deletes its subtasks too, keeping their data for undo.
A dependency that would make a loop is refused with a message.

cases.about: Adding a dependency.
Dragging in Next places the task halfway between its new neighbours; dropping at the end goes 1000 past the last.
Dropping at the end of Next.
Deleting a project sends its tasks to the Inbox (a flag they had is kept).
Deleting an area keeps its projects, without an area.
